backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Build a ZKTime .db from this app's data and choose where to save it.
backup.prune: Remove people this app no longer has
backup.built_on: Built on the ZKTime backup saved {{date}} — its settings, shifts, departments and logins are carried over untouched.
backup.no_template: No template yet. Most of a ZKTime database is its own configuration, which this app cannot invent — so a backup is built on a real one. Restore a ZKTime .db and this fills in by itself, or pick one here.
backup.template_unreadable: The stored template can no longer be read: {{problem}}

restore.title: Restore
restore.subtitle: Read a ZKTime .db into this app. Adds only; running it twice changes nothing.
restore.will_be_added: In this file — will be added

part_hints.employees: Names, PINs and cards. Fills in blanks; never overwrites what you typed.
part_hints.attendance: The punches themselves. This is the part that cannot be re-read from the terminal.
part_hints.templates: Stored as a copy only. Whether a ZKTime template can be pushed back to a terminal has not been verified, so nothing sends them automatically.

restore.no_employees_warning: Without Employees, punches for anyone off the roster are stored but hidden on the Attendance screen.
restore.will_create: {{name}} is not registered here yet. Restoring adds it from this file, approved in your name, with the default timezone. Check that timezone on the device’s page afterwards — the restored punches are labelled with it.
restore.will_create_ip: {{name}} is not registered here yet. Restoring adds it from this file ({{ip}}), approved in your name, with the default timezone. Check that timezone on the device’s page afterwards — the restored punches are labelled with it.
restore.times_note: Times are stored exactly as the file records them, labelled with the chosen device’s timezone. Nothing is shifted.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Privileged and physical actions, attributed to an actor and source IP.

hrm.title: HRM Attendance Sync
hrm.subtitle: Pushes new attendance records to your HRM server on a schedule.
hrm.pause_title: Stop pushing records to the HRM until resumed
hrm.resume_title: Start pushing records to the HRM again
hrm.secret_keep: leave blank to keep the current secret
